title: Not Great, Not Terrible, But Okay
text: Not Great, Not Terrible, But Okay. To make things easier for myself as an old guy, I use a lot of disposable plates, plastic silverware, and cups. So I have plenty of experience with disposable coffee cups. The best are sturdy and durable enough for repeated use. The worst are so flimsy, they feel like they will collapse in your hand the first time you use them. These cups sit firmly in the middle between those two extremes. The lids feel lightweight and flimsy. They also have to be firmly and carefully snapped into place. Otherwise, it looks like they are set in place but they really are not. That can be a painful mistake when dealing with hot liquids. The cups themselves are thin enough that you do need to use the sleeves in order to hold them when they are full of hot coffee. I have used better disposable cups that are thick enough to not need the extra insulation. Thicker cups also keep the coffee hot for longer than these cups do. Still, there are plenty of cheap, disposable cups that are much worse than these. So I give this product a firm, middle of the pack, 3 star rating.
